title: Flowwood product
description: One product: one file content/products/<id>.json, listed by id in content/catalog.json → products. Every product page, product card, cart line and shop entry is built from these fields alone. Two kinds: a sized product (sizing + pricing.base/perSizeStep, made to order, custom sizes possible) or a fixed product (dimensions + pricing.fixed).

id.description: Lowercase words joined by hyphens, e.g. "smoked-oak".

localized.description: The same text in every language of the site.

fileName.description: Name and extension of a file in content/media, e.g. "monolith-1.webp". The build reads its width and height from the file.

position.description: Focal point kept in view when the photo is cropped: horizontal then vertical, e.g. "50% 60%". Default "50% 50%".

thumbnail.description: Optional small version shown in photo strips, filters and the cart. Without it the photo itself is shown small.

color.description: Swatch colour: a hex colour ("#3b332d") or a CSS gradient.

$schema.description: Lets an editor check the file: "../../model.json".

id.description: Unique and permanent, and the same as the file name (monolith → content/products/monolith.json): it is the product's web address (/nl/winkel/<id>/) and is stored in visitors' carts.

name.description: Product name, the same in every language.

tone.description: Brightness of the lower left of the main photo; the home hero picks its text colour from it.

image.description: Main photo: product cards, hero, shop and the first photo on the product page.

altImage.description: Second photo: shown when hovering a product card, and second on the product page.

gallery.description: Further photos on the product page, in order, after image and altImage.

summary.description: One short line under the name, e.g. "Square · smoked oak veneer". Also the page title.

description.description: "About this piece" on the product page and the search-engine description. Without it the summary is used.

dimensions.description: Fixed products only: size as shown, e.g. "Ø 22 × 26 cm". Sized products derive their dimensions from sizing.

heights.description: Standard heights in cm, low to high. The first is the starting price.

base.description: Sized: price at the lowest height.

perSizeStep.description: Sized: added for each next standard height.

availability.description: Stock or lead time on the product page, e.g. "Back in stock in March". Without it: the standard in-stock line (fixed) or made-to-order lead time (sized).

related.description: Ids of other products shown under "You may also like" at the bottom of the product page, in order, each with its own add-to-cart. An id that is not (or no longer) in the shop is skipped.

finishes.description: Colours or materials to choose from; the first is the default. A fixed product has exactly one.
